author: sjm41
body:
Hi,

In https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30326, I relabelled and redefined GO:0004376 'glycolipid mannosyltransferase activity' to the more specific 'GPI mannosyltransferase activity'. This was because that's how the term had been used in almost all annotations to date.

However, there are two annotations to ALG-type mannosyltransferases (involved in making the N-glycan precursor) that need changing:

**DictyBase:** (@pfey03)
alg2	Alpha-1,3/1,6-mannosyltransferase ALG2
glycolipid mannosyltransferase activity ISS	UniProtKB:P43636 (S. cerevisiae ALG2)


**ZFIN** (@sramachand)
alg2	ALG2 alpha-1,3/1,6-mannosyltransferase
glycolipid mannosyltransferase activity ISS		UniProtKB:P43636 (S. cerevisiae ALG2)


However, I don't see a current annotation for S. cerevisiae to this term...
So, I'd suggest removing that ISS and checking whether you want to make a new ISS to current GO annotation(s), probably:
GDP-Man:Man1GlcNAc2-PP-Dol alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity (GO:0004378)
and
GDP-Man:Man2GlcNAc2-PP-dolichol alpha-1,6-mannosyltransferase activity (GO:0102704)
title: Review ISS annotations to Dicty alg2 and zebrafish alg2
